title: REPRISE Phase 7: additional experiments on five limitations (first appearance, backbone dependence, separation of memory and propagation, dataset dependence, design space of stream conditions)
request: User (2026-10-03): 追加実験をしてください。・初出の画像への対応 ・DINOv2依存(軽量モデルやその他) ・メモリと伝播の役割を完全に分離する ・データセット依存 ・ストリーム条件の設計空間
status_at_writing: Written before any Phase 7 score is computed. Existing results that were already seen: Phase 4 (U1/U2 with frozen v5 and the minimal configurations, Exp 4-8), Phase 5 (dev1/dev2/U4/OpenOOD test with frozen v5 and the two-sided lock), Phase 6 (dev1/dev2 with DINOv3 views).

frozen_method.name: REPRISE v5 (unchanged)
frozen_method.labels: 16 images per ID class: 12 support + 4 calibration

static.K: CLIP ViT-B/16 zero-shot top-20 ID classes

frozen_method.score: s0 * prod_views p_M * p_LP; standalone means s0 = 1
frozen_method.zeta: best minimal configuration of Phase 4: robust z of the zero-start u through the normal cdf, k10 g1 l0.9
frozen_method.metrics: metrics_p4.metrics: AUROC (ID positive), FPR95 at the empirical threshold accepting >= 95% of ID (ties accepted)

never_opened: OpenOOD v1.5 test images (sealed manifest guard; 6 uses so far, no 7th in this phase)
Four-OOD sets (iNaturalist / SUN / Places / DTD under datasets/extra_ood)
data_policy.selection: dev1 only (free exploration). dev2: confirmation of a locked candidate only, at most 3 attempts. No selection on any other data.
data_policy.evaluation_banks: U1, U2 (Phase 4) and U4 (Phase 5) were scored before (frozen v5; U4 also the Phase 5 lock). Here they are used (i) descriptively with frozen methods, no selection, and (ii) for a single evaluation of a candidate locked on dev1/dev2 (experiment A). They are 'not used for selection', not 'unused'.
data_policy.downloads: None. Only weights and data already on hades. Encoders that would need a download (DINOv3 ViT-S/16, S+/16, ConvNeXt-T; CLIP RN50) are run only if the user permits it later; they would be reported as an addendum.
data_policy.post_hoc: Anything decided after seeing Phase 7 scores (outside the dev1 selection of A) is labelled post hoc / descriptive.

definitions.appearance_index: k = 1 + number of earlier stream images (arrival order) of the same unknown class; first appearance: k = 1
definitions.miss_rate: share of the OOD images of a bin with score >= the stream's ID-95% threshold (the FPR95 threshold of that detector on that stream)
definitions.auroc_bin: AUROC of the bin's OOD images against all ID images of the stream

A_first_appearance.A1_descriptive: U1 (5 splits x 3 draws x 3 orders, Phase 4 scores): miss rate and AUROC per bin for static p, memory only, p_LP only, zeta, static x p_LP, frozen REPRISE. Unit: split.

A2_candidates.form: sum over views of [ a * log p_static + log p_mem + trunc_tau(log p_lp) ], entrance sets, graph and thresholds frozen

memory_readout.Mh<c>, c in {0,1,2,3,4}: one-sided (hinge) memory: g = d + max(0, c - (rho - med)/mad); the calibration images are scored with the same formula. c -> infinity is the frozen read-out, an empty memory gives the static p

lp_truncation_tau.rule: log p_lp replaced by min(0, log(p_lp / tau)); tau = 1 is no truncation

A2_candidates.exploration: dev1 may be explored further (new candidates) before the lock; every candidate ever evaluated on dev1 is listed in the report.

A2_selection_rule_dev1.streams: dev1 near and far, 5 draws x 3 orders, standalone unless stated; unit: draw
A2_selection_rule_dev1.objective: minimise F1 = first-appearance (k = 1) miss rate on the near streams
constraints: x TINS near FPR95 <= frozen x TINS + 0.30
A2_selection_rule_dev1.tie_break: among candidates within 0.5 points of the minimum F1: fewest changed components (a != 0, memory != M, lp != lp0, tau != 1); then larger c; then larger tau; then smaller a
A2_selection_rule_dev1.no_selection: if no candidate other than frozen satisfies the constraints, or the F1 gain of the selected one is < 1.0 point, no remedy is locked and the negative result is reported

criteria: F1 difference (candidate - frozen): 95% t interval upper bound < 0
overall near FPR95 difference: point <= +0.30 and upper bound < +1.0

A3_evaluation_after_lock.lock: selection_lock_p7.json (sha256) written after the dev2 confirmation and before any candidate metric is computed on U1/U4
A3_evaluation_after_lock.U1_U4_natural: 45 streams each; F1, miss rate per bin, overall AUROC / FPR95 (standalone, x TINS), candidate - frozen, unit split
A3_evaluation_after_lock.intervention: Exp 4 design (U1, 250 split-class pairs, history 768 ID + 256 OOD, r in {0,1,2,5,10,20} same-class replacements): AUROC of the candidate, frozen REPRISE and static p; bootstrap over pairs

criteria.P1: U1 F1 difference (candidate - frozen): upper bound < 0
criteria.P2: U1 overall standalone FPR95 difference: upper bound < +1.0
criteria.P3: intervention r = 0: AUROC(candidate) - AUROC(static p), bootstrap 95% lower bound > -0.5 ('first-appearance deficit removed')

B_backbone.design: Frozen hyper-parameters, K(x), s0, shots and streams; only the visual views change. Every single view is run once per stream; a multi-view result is the product over its views (v5 has no cross-view interaction).

views.D3B: DINOv3 ViT-B/16 CLS after final norm, 256 px (Resize 293 + CenterCrop 256), as Phase 6
views.DINO1: DINO ViT-B/16 (ImageNet-1K images, no labels; timm vit_base_patch16_224.dino) CLS
views.MAE: MAE ViT-B/16 (ImageNet-1K images, no labels; timm vit_base_patch16_224.mae) CLS
views.CLIP: CLIP ViT-B/16 image embedding (the VLM's own features: no extra encoder)
views.SIG2L: SigLIP2 large patch16-256 image embedding (transformers, cached)

B_backbone.input: DINOv2 / DINO / MAE: Resize 256 bicubic + CenterCrop 224, ImageNet mean/std. DINOv3: 256 px as above. CLIP / SigLIP2: their own processors.
B_backbone.excluded: ImageNet-1K-supervised encoders (ResNet, ConvNeXt, ViT-augreg, BEiT/Swin fine-tuned): the unknown classes of U1 are ImageNet-1K classes, so their labels were used in pre-training.
B_backbone.data: U1: 5 splits x 3 draws x 3 orders; U2 (ImageNet-O): 5 draws x 3 orders. Features of the new views are extracted for the shot, ID-evaluation and OOD-evaluation images of the Phase 4 pool and ImageNet-O.
B_backbone.outcomes: standalone and x TINS AUROC / FPR95 of static p, zeta, memory only, REPRISE; REPRISE - zeta and REPRISE - static p within each view set (paired, unit split / draw); 12-shot nearest-class-mean accuracy on the ID evaluation images, parameters, encoding time per image (RTX 2080 Ti, fp32).

confirmatory_H_B.statement: Views (L14, D3L) give a lower U1 standalone FPR95 than the frozen (B14, L14) with v5 unchanged (configuration chosen post hoc on dev1/dev2 in Phase 6: -5.8 on both).
confirmatory_H_B.test: paired difference over the 5 U1 splits (each the mean of 9 streams); confirmed if the 95% t interval upper bound < 0

C1_intervention_2x2.data: Exp 4 per-query scores (Phase 4, no new run): for each of the 250 split-class pairs and r in {1,2,5,10,20}, the history H_r with r same-class images and H_0 without.
C1_intervention_2x2.cells: score = log p_M[H_a] + log p_LP[H_b], (a,b) in {0,r}^2. In v5 the memory and the propagation do not read each other, so mixing the factors of two runs is exactly the intervention 'the recurrence is visible to the memory only / the graph only / both / neither'.
C1_intervention_2x2.effects: E_M = AUROC(r,0) - AUROC(0,0); E_G = AUROC(0,r) - AUROC(0,0); E_MG = AUROC(r,r) - AUROC(0,0); interaction I = E_MG - E_M - E_G. AUROC per pair: 8 class queries vs 64 common ID queries. Percentile bootstrap over pairs (10,000 resamples, seed 20261003) and split-cluster bootstrap. Also for the contents near / far / dup.

C_separation.C2_pure_signals: U1 natural streams (45): three separate calibrated ranks per view: static (d), memory proximity alone (rank of the nearest-member distance rho against the calibration images' rho; no d), propagation (u). AUROC / FPR95 of each, of every product, and of the frozen p_M x p_LP; miss rate per appearance bin; overlap of detections at each detector's ID-95% threshold; Spearman correlation of the log ranks within ID and within OOD.

propagation.alone: graph = support + calibration + the image alone (no test-time information), zero start
propagation.batch: graph = support + calibration + the current batch only

C3_history_2x2.data: U1: 'alone' on splits 1-5, draw 0, order 123 (5 streams; exact per-image computation); 'batch' and 'history' on all 45 streams
C3_history_2x2.outcome: AUROC / FPR95 of the cells; main effects and interaction of streaming memory and streaming propagation; unit split

D_datasets.protocol: Same frozen configuration as ImageNet (nothing tuned). Views DINOv2 B/14 + L/14, K(x) from CLIP ViT-B/16 zero-shot on the ID class names (TINS positive prompt), 16 labelled images per ID class (12 + 4, seeded), batch 256, TINS order rule, 5 class splits x 3 orders; unit split. Bases: none and MCM.

datasets.cub: CUB-200-2011: 150 ID / 50 unknown classes (random); shots from the train split; ID stream = test images of the ID classes; OOD = test images of the unknown classes
datasets.cub_ssb: SSB CUB (authors' split): 100 known classes, OOD = Easy / Medium / Hard test images (three streams per order); shots as Phase 3
datasets.cifar100: CIFAR-100: 50 / 50 classes (random); shots from train; ID / OOD = test images
datasets.places365: Places365-Standard val (100 per class): 292 / 73 classes; 16 shots per ID class from val, the other 84 are the ID stream; OOD = the 100 images of each unknown class. Images identical (sha256) to a sealed or Four-OOD image are dropped. Note: 5,500 val images of 275 classes served as far-OOD in the R5 development streams.
datasets.imagenet_r: ImageNet-R (200 classes): 160 / 40 classes; 16 shots per ID class from ImageNet-R itself; ID = the other images of the ID classes (at most 100 per class, seeded); OOD = images of the unknown classes (at most 100 per class)
datasets.imagenet_sketch: ImageNet-Sketch: the five U1 class splits (900 ID / 100 unknown sibling classes); 16 sketch shots per ID class, 20 ID images per ID class, 50 images per unknown class: the same classes and composition as U1, different image domain

D_datasets.class_splits: seeded (20261003 + split index); recorded with the bank before features are scored
D_datasets.matched_condition: every dataset (and U1) also with the same composition: 40 unknown classes x 25 images (1,000 OOD) and 4,000 ID images (seeded subsamples of the natural streams; unknown classes with fewer than 25 images are not eligible), to separate the image domain from the stream composition
D_datasets.outcomes: AUROC / FPR95 of static p, zeta, memory only, static x p_LP, REPRISE (standalone, x MCM); REPRISE - zeta and REPRISE - static p; same-feature kNN and Mahalanobis++ (Phase 3 registered parameters) as static references; descriptors: classes, unknown classes, images per unknown class, OOD share, stream length, 12-shot NCM accuracy, share of OOD images whose nearest stream neighbour (L/14) is of the same unknown class

E_stream_design_space.bank: U1 splits 1-5, shots of draw 0, frozen REPRISE and the reference detectors; standalone and x MCM (TINS is stream-dependent and is not re-run). Images of an unknown class: all 210 pool images of that class (shot / ID-evaluation / long / OOD-evaluation roles; none is used as a shot in that split).

E1_composition.kept: cells with U*m >= 100 (19 per n_id level)
E1_composition.extra: n_id = 72,000 (ID evaluation + long images) with U = 100 and m in {1, 5, 20, 50, 200}

patterns.ood_burst: the images of an unknown class arrive consecutively, bursts at random positions
patterns.id_first: the first half of the ID images before any OOD
patterns.ood_early: all OOD within the first third of the stream
patterns.emerging: unknown class j appears only after position 0.8 N j / U and is then spread uniformly over the rest
patterns.two_visits: each unknown class arrives in two bursts (half each), one in the first 40% and one in the last 40% of the stream

E_stream_design_space.E4_time_course: from the E1/E2 runs and the Phase 4 scores: ID false-alarm rate at a fixed threshold and OOD miss rate by stream decile
E_stream_design_space.outcomes: AUROC / FPR95 of static p, zeta, memory only, static x p_LP, REPRISE (and, after the lock of A, the locked candidate); differences REPRISE - static p and REPRISE - zeta per cell; response surface over (m, OOD share, stream length)
E_stream_design_space.all: descriptive (no selection); the m = 1 cells are streams made only of first appearances

statistics.split_unit: paired differences over the 5 splits (streams of a split averaged), 95% t interval (df = 4)
statistics.draw_unit: dev1 / dev2 / U2: 5 draws (orders averaged), df = 4
statistics.pairs: intervention: percentile bootstrap over the 250 pairs, plus a split-cluster bootstrap
statistics.multiplicity: one confirmatory hypothesis in B and the criteria P1-P3 in A; everything else is descriptive and reported with intervals, without significance claims

verification: engine7 reproduces the Phase 4 scores of U1 streams (static, memory, warm p_LP, zeta) and the Phase 5 dev scores
independent re-computation of the headline numbers from the saved scores
deviations: recorded under $P7/failures and in the report
